purpose_note: NOT a runtime artifact, NOT AC/BCM source of truth, NOT generator input, NOT normal release content. Strictly a validated frozen combo recovery snapshot.

archive.storage_note: External archive. NOT in MOD worktree, NOT in standard release package.

root_hash_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 encoded concatenation of lines, where each line is canonical_path<TAB>size<TAB>lowercase_sha256, lines sorted by ordinal canonical_path, LF between lines, no trailing LF

historical_source.note: 31 character directories containing 965 Frozen V2 JSON files. This source was the candidate corpus used to build the backup archive.

restoration.procedure: 1. Verify archive SHA-256 against this manifest. 2. Extract ZIP preserving canonical paths. 3. Verify each extracted file SHA-256 against files[] entries. 4. Recompute root hash and compare to manifest root_hash.
restoration.note: Restored files follow the MOD canonical install layout but this backup is NOT intended for normal MOD installation.

immutability.policy: This snapshot is immutable. Do not modify files within this archive. Future stable recovery points create new snapshots (v2, v3, ...); this v1 snapshot is never overwritten.

secondary_backup.note: A second independent copy of this archive has not yet been created. At least one additional copy on NAS/remote storage/other device is recommended for disaster recovery.

old_character_zips.note: 31 individual character ZIP files in the source candidate directory are distribution artifacts, not independent data authorities. This manifest is the canonical integrity record.

character_aggregate_hash_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 encoded concatenation of lines, where each line is canonical_path<TAB>size<TAB>lowercase_sha256, restricted to files belonging to the character, lines sorted by ordinal canonical_path, LF between lines, no trailing LF
